egory: Social Media Management Primary Use: A streamlined tool for scheduling posts and engaging with audiences without over-complicating workflows. Why It Matters (2026): It now features an AI assistant to brainstorm ideas and a "Start Page" feature that serves as a built-in landing page for social links. Notes: Free tier for up to 3 accounts; paid plans provide more detailed analytics.
Tool: Phantombuster Supports Services: Service 2 – social media and engagement & automation Category: Lead Generation Automation Primary Use: Automates tasks on LinkedIn and Instagram like auto-connecting, liking posts, and monitoring brand mentions. Why It Matters (2026): It helps sales teams generate business leads and marketing audiences on autopilot by interacting with specific niches and competitors. Notes: Integrates with Sales Navigator and Slack for real-time lead alerts.
